name: browser-profile-attribution
goal: Record page measurements only for the explicitly exercised route owner, never a fixed list of possibly inactive shared units.

evidence: pageBenchmark copies every route timing and heap observation onto a fixed shared-unit list, including entity header and summary units on list routes. Those modules are not established as executed by this capture, so their copied samples cannot prove coverage.

The standard collector protocol matrix asserts metrics and target for the route but filters away other subjects. Require the complete measurement subject set to equal the explicit route owner, preserving build, revision, soft-navigation, positive-metric and inspector-cleanup controls.

This repair changes the browser test collector itself. Harness correctly rejects a product-regression green because the frozen test support changes. Track it as a verification-workflow feature, retaining actual before/after protocol results and unchanged assertion source. No renderer regression pair or waived final task check is claimed.
